clients.notes: Genesis agents client. Signs requests via vault-bound Ed25519 keypair (cato/vault_crypto.py, CATO_AP2_PUBKEY). Key rotated 2026-08-13 after Cato's vault was rebuilt: the 2026-05-17 key ZgBMq0+O0CXEp1eWG8JdMsikQNT6SPWh4Hop5vbg7QQ= was DELETED, not disabled, because its private half is unrecoverable and no operator controls it. A disabled record is still a key nobody controls sitting in the trust store; deletion is the only state that cannot be re-enabled by accident.
